highlights.text: 1988 North Country Super Bowl at Watertown (Saranac Lake 21, Watertown 12): offensive player of the game, 19 carries for 94 yards and a 47-yard touchdown run.
1988 regular season through Oct. 21: 245 yards on 50 carries, 3 touchdowns, 18 points (team stats in the Enterprise).
1987 varsity roster: No. 22, running back and linebacker, on the CVAC champion team.
1986 junior varsity: touchdowns against AuSable Valley and Saranac Central.
Listed among the Saranac Lake Central High School graduates of 1989 as Shane G. Graham.

shane-graham.team_record: 1988 team: 9-1, CVAC and North Country Super Bowl champions
